verses.text: A psalm. Sing the LORD a new song! He’s done wonders. His own right hand and holy arm won the victory.
The LORD has let everyone see how he saves. He’s shown his righteousness in plain sight of the nations.
He remembered his faithful love and loyalty to the house of Israel. People at the ends of the earth have seen our God save.
Shout for joy to the LORD, all the earth! Let the praise burst out in song!
Sing praises to the LORD with the harp. Let the harp and your voices make music together.
With trumpets and the blast of the ram’s horn, shout for joy before the King, the LORD.
Let the sea roar with everything in it. Let the world roar with everyone who lives in it.
Let the rivers clap their hands! Let the mountains sing for joy together.
Let them sing before the LORD, because he’s coming to judge the earth. He’ll judge the world with righteousness and treat the peoples fairly.
